svg.text: For the missions that cannot fail

g.font-family: Georgia,'Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,'Times New Roman',serif
g.text: Sovereign, high-assurance systems for the decisions that cannot be wrong —
in space, in law, in finance, and across the regulated enterprise. Results are
reproducible, standards are public, and nothing phones home.†
